description: This file provides utility functions for set operations on string slices, including difference, union, subtraction, filtering Unicode characters, and set containment logic.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks whether a given string exists and is enabled within a simpleSet.

methods.name: DistinctValues
methods.description: Returns the set of values that are unique to each slice (symmetric difference).

methods.name: SetSubtract
methods.description: Subtracts a set of strings from another set of strings.

methods.name: SetUnion
methods.description: Returns the union of two slices of strings.

methods.name: sliceToSimpleSet
methods.description: Converts a slice of strings into a simpleSet map.

methods.name: discardKeysFromOther
methods.description: Removes common elements from one set based on another set.

methods.name: allKeys
methods.description: Aggregates all unique keys from multiple simpleSets.

methods.name: FilterNoUnicode
methods.description: Removes Unicode characters outside the ASCII range from a string.
